For entrees we had the spaghetti Carbonara (requested with no bacon) with beef tenderloin sliced on top. This pasta was incredible, rich sauce but was balanced out by other components of the dish. My husband ordered the rack of lamb, the lamb was cooked beautifully and tender, the risotto was slightly more al dente than out liking but still enjoyable. We both said we would both order the pasta next time when we return!

Finally despite being very full we shared the feature cheese cake (chocolate chunk with raspberry couli) this was a lovely pairing and perfect amount of sweetness.

The complimentary focaccia was so good we had to order an additional side for some leftovers to take home!

Review Comments:
Made our reservation based on the reviews, and we're happy to report they hold up. We were promptly greeted and shown to our table — a great first impression. The space itself has an eclectic, lively energy that sets the tone nicely; it was busy without feeling chaotic.
We started with drinks and the caprese salad. The house Pinot Noir was decent but unremarkable — the one forgettable note of the evening. The caprese, on the other hand, was bright and flavorful. Highly recommend starting there.
For my entrée, I went with the rack of lamb crusted in mustard and horseradish — a genuinely excellent dish with bold, well-balanced flavors. My one minor critique is the plating: once you cut into it, the lamb's juices from the sides bleed into the crust, robbing it of the crispiness that makes the dish. A small tweak in presentation would elevate an already impressive plate.
Overall, a thoroughly enjoyable dinner. The food, the atmosphere, and the hospitality all delivered. We'd recommend II Terrazzo without hesitation.

Review Comments:
A Hidden Gem on the Pacific Coast: Il Terrazzo Ristorante, Victoria BC

Some dining experiences simply stop you in your tracks. This was one of them.

---

We arrived without a reservation — spontaneous, a little hopeful, perhaps slightly reckless — and yet Il Terrazzo welcomed us as though they'd been expecting us all along. That alone told me everything about the warmth of this place.

Tucked away in the heart of Victoria, Il Terrazzo has a personality all its own. We were seated on the little outdoor terrasse, and honestly, I could have spent the entire evening there just soaking in the atmosphere before a single bite arrived. Cobblestones, candlelight, the gentle hum of a city that somehow feels both cosmopolitan and intimately small. Magic.

---

The Food — Where Do I Even Begin?

The focaccia and tapenade arrived first, and let me tell you — bread has absolutely no business being this good. The focaccia was pillowy, golden, kissed with olive oil in all the right ways. The tapenade? Bold, briny, deeply flavourful. We demolished it embarrassingly fast and had zero regrets.

Then came the moment of the evening: the Carpaccio.

I want to be clear about something. I have eaten carpaccio on multiple continents, in celebrated restaurants, in tiny trattorias in Italy, in spots that boasted Michelin pedigree. I consider myself something of a connoisseur. And yet — yet — Il Terrazzo's version stopped me cold. The genius move? Butternut squash. I never, in all my years of dining, would have thought to pair the silky richness of carpaccio with the sweet earthiness of butternut squash. It sounds unexpected. It is unexpected. And it is absolutely, undeniably brilliant. One of those bites that makes you put your fork down and just... think.

We followed that with the Halibut with balsamic reduction — perfectly cooked, flaky and delicate, the balsamic lending just the right amount of acidity and sweetness to complement the fish without ever overpowering it. Clean, elegant, confident cooking.

---

A Canadian Wine Revelation

Here's a confession: I arrived at Il Terrazzo knowing very little about Canadian wine. I left as a convert.

Our server guided us toward the Winemaker's Cut Cabernet Sauvignon from the Okanagan Valley, BC — and what followed was a full-blown wine education in a single glass. Rich, structured, deeply satisfying. The Okanagan Valley, it turns out, produces wines that can stand proudly on any world stage. Canada and serious winemaking? Who knew. I know now, and I will be seeking this bottle out again.

---

#The Verdict

Il Terrazzo is the kind of restaurant that reminds you why you love to eat. The kind of place where spontaneity is rewarded, where every dish tells a story, and where you leave not just full, but genuinely happy. From the terrasse to the tapenade, from the revelatory carpaccio to that gorgeous Okanagan red — every single moment of this meal was a joy.

We will absolutely, unquestionably be back.

Go. No reservation needed — just an appetite and an open mind. 🍷

Il Terrazzo was warm and welcoming from the moment we walked in. We were seated in the cutest little corner that felt authentically Italian -- cozy, intimate, and full of charm.

As someone with celiac who also loves food, dining out can be stressful, but their gluten‑free awareness absolutely blew me away. The staff didn't just offer GF options -- they understood them. Our server was incredible: knowledgeable, kind, and completely confident about every accommodation available. I never once felt like a burden for asking questions.

The food was delicious, the atmosphere was beautiful, and the care they put into allergy‑friendly dining made the whole experience feel special. Highly recommend for anyone with celiac, allergies, or food sensitivities -- and for anyone who just wants a truly lovely meal.

The kindest hostess, highly knowledgeable and informative waiters and waitress, beautifully ambience, and the best food you can get in Victoria hands down! I recommend requesting to have Eric he was an excellent waiter!

A Perfect 41st Anniversary Dinner - My wife and I celebrated our 41st wedding anniversary at Il Terrazzo, and it was an absolutely wonderful evening from start to finish.

The atmosphere is charming and romantic, with exposed brick walls, beautiful timber beams, and a glass ceiling that gives the restaurant a warm and inviting feel. It feels special the moment you walk in.

The service was outstanding—friendly, attentive, and perfectly paced. We never felt rushed and were able to relax and enjoy the evening.

The food was exceptional. I started with the tomato soup, which was delicious, and followed it with the Spaghetti Carbonara, which is topped with a perfectly cooked tenderloin steak slices. Debbie began with a fresh salad, Formaggio di Capra, and then had the Spaghetti ai Fuoco, both excellent vegetarian choices.

To finish, we shared the cheesecake, which was fantastic, along with two of the best cappuccinos we've had in a very long time.

What made the evening truly memorable was how everything came together: the atmosphere, the service, the food, and the opportunity to celebrate an important milestone together. It was a perfect anniversary dinner, and we look forward to returning the next time we're in Victoria.

Highly recommended.
